speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is in. I am not going to read you a sum. The book is shut on the sum, and open on the week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then keep it shut. I will not ask a total you have not offered.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thursday's seven shillings is entered. I will not enter it twice. The leaf is signed, and nothing struck.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Monday. No play. The house is dark. It is the Queen's day.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: There is a tilt. The company is not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house is dark. That is all I need of Monday.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tuesday, the king, and you are Gaunt. Wednesday morning, the lovers, read at Holywell. The company has not read them. Wednesday afternoon, the Shrew, and not you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday morning, and not before. I will not have it in pieces at a door.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thursday, Navarre. You are in it. Friday, the Shrew. You are in it. Saturday, Two Gentlemen. You are in it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And my name is on the fan-carrier's roll, Sweet Master Shakespeare. You wrote the player where another man would write the part.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You would like it better. The fan is the part. I am not opening a new tally for it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not asking you to open the book. I can count a roll when it is in my hand, and it is not in my hand today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The rolls are not out. The reading is Wednesday. Nobody is to startle the boy between this and that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody startles him. The lovers are read on Wednesday. They are not played.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The feast is sixteen bars, and the viol down. I will not teach it again before the parts are out.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The three nights stand as they were said. St Stephen's, the Navarre comedy. St John's, the lovers. Innocents', something old to laugh at. Not the king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not the king. We do not choose the old one today.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Clean hose was said of the whole company already. I am not making it a new order.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No money from that quarter has come. Do not spend it. Seven shillings is the only fee I am entering, and it is entered.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You have had my you, Master Shakespeare, and you will have it until you earn a worse word. I will not invent a sum John will not read.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You. And your supper. The tally stays open, and I have nothing to lay on it tonight.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday dark. Tuesday the king. Wednesday the reading, then the Shrew without you. Thursday Navarre. Friday the Shrew. Saturday Two Gentlemen. Seven shillings already in. No new total.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The book stays shut. I will not have a sum guessed at a door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book stays shut. I am going home to a letter I have not answered.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Answer it or do not. The sixteen bars will keep.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The letter is not this book. Good night.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good night, Sweet Master Shakespeare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night.
